import sys, json, random, time, ctypes, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from gen import rand_domain, rand_predicate

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 99)

def build(ncells_wanted, domsize, npreds, width, ntrain, nqueries, mode):
    if mode == 'wide':
        fields=[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':list(range(domsize))}]
        slots=1
    else:
        # 4 fields x 4 slots, binary domains -> 2^16
        fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':rng.choice(['count','id','flag','size','time']),
                 'domain':[0,1] if rng.random()<0.7 else [0,1,2]} for i in range(4)]
        slots=4
    preds=[]
    for _ in range(npreds):
        try: preds.append(rand_predicate(rng, fields, slots))
        except IndexError: pass
    cell_doms=[f['domain'] for _ in range(slots) for f in fields]
    total=1
    for d in cell_doms: total*=len(d)
    idxs=list(range(total)); rng.shuffle(idxs)
    train=[]
    for i in range(ntrain):
        u=idxs[i%total]
        flat=[cell_doms[c][ (u // (total// (1 if c==len(cell_doms)-1 else 1))) ] for c in range(0)]
        # decode mixed radix
        vals=[]; rem=u
        for c in range(len(cell_doms)-1,-1,-1):
            r=len(cell_doms[c]); vals.append(cell_doms[c][rem % r]); rem//=r
        vals=vals[::-1]
        train.append([list(vals[s*len(fields):(s+1)*len(fields)]) for s in range(slots)])
    approved=[sorted(rng.sample(range(len(preds)), rng.randint(1,width))) for _ in range(16)]
    queries=[]
    for _ in range(nqueries):
        cells=slots*len(fields)
        order=list(range(cells)); rng.shuffle(order)
        nf_=len(fields)
        nfixed=rng.randint(0, min(2, cells-1))
        fixed=[{'ref':[c//nf_, fields[c%nf_]['name']], 'value': rng.choice(fields[c%nf_]['domain'])} for c in order[:nfixed]]
        t=order[nfixed]
        queries.append({'fixed':fixed,'target':[t//nf_, fields[t%nf_]['name']],
                        'prefix': rng.choice(['','0','1','10','01','9','123','000','1000000','55'])})
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':width,'train':train,
            'approved':approved,'queries':queries}

for mode in ['wide','many']:
    job = build(0, 65536, 32, 4, 10000, 64, mode)
    t0=time.time()
    out=compile_job(job)
    el=time.time()-t0
    nwin = 1
    for f in job['fields']:
        nwin *= len(f['domain'])
    nwin **= job['slots']
    print(f"mode={mode} universe={nwin} preds={len(job['predicates'])} train={len(job['train'])} "
          f"rules={len(out['rules'])} active={len(out['active'])} answers={len(out['answers'])} time={el:.2f}s")
